prompt: Built-in imagegen: nine crude prehistoric finds in a square 3x3 warm ivory paper and matte gouache swatch. Cells: dragged ochre handprint, shell separating fibers, stone bruising roots, twig mixing earth pigments, knot caught in bark slit, small stone levering a larger one, bark-wrapped charcoal, tooth piercing leaf, hide over stone hollow.

entries.review: Top-left: broad red ochre palm smear with motion streak on an irregular cave-rock fragment.
Top-middle: jagged natural shell separating two coarse tufts of plant fibers, no manufactured comb.
Top-right: blunt handstone bearing down on flattened pale roots on bare earth.
Middle-left: crooked twig stirring pale and red earth pigment in an uneven rock hollow.
Middle-middle: coarse plant-fiber tie caught along a narrow natural slit in tree bark.
Middle-right: small wedge stone lifting one end of a much larger rough stone.
Bottom-left: black charcoal stub loosely enclosed by a ragged bark curl.
Bottom-middle: loose animal tooth tip driven through the surface of a broad leaf.
Bottom-right: raw hide stretched over a natural rock hollow and held by two pebbles.
